fusions.name: Stooping Talons
fusions.desc: You dive up to 7 tiles onto the target and strike for 13 damage, leaving it 10% easier to wound for 4 seconds and [Pinned] for 1.5 seconds.

fusions.name: Hooded Quarry
fusions.desc: Throws a hood that deals 8 damage and leaves the target [Blunted] for 5 seconds. It holds 4 charges, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Loosed Falcon
fusions.desc: Looses a falcon for 10 seconds. Every 1.2 seconds it strikes an enemy within 5 tiles and deals 4 damage, with a 30% chance to leave the target [Slowed] for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Pit Canary
fusions.desc: Once every 300 seconds, a blow that would kill you leaves you at 1 health instead.
